_comment: Source-of-truth for the NYXUS accent palette. ALIEN NEON is the canonical 'prism' preset (violet #7d3dff / magenta #ff2dad / orange #ff8a1e / green #39ff14) — all consumer files are hand-edited in these exact colors, and nyxus-apply-accent derives its baselines from them. Edited via Quick Settings → Accent or `nyxus accent set <name>`. follow_wallpaper is LOCKED OFF (owner directive 2026-07-23): the palette must never drift with wallpaper changes — that drift is how the desktop kept losing its alien look.
